audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 renders as Skill while whys[0] says you out-DPS him outright and early says 'never respect his level-1'; 2+ items renders as Skill while whys[6] and late both say All Out flips the lane. The packet reads Urgot x6 / K'Sante.
audit.why: K'Sante's early resistances are thin relative to his health pool, so Urgot wins from level 1; past two items All Out's shortened cooldowns, true damage and healing take the duel outright. Neither endpoint is a coinflip.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Urgot (6/10) and 2+ items -> K'Sante (3/10) as matched full+content pairs, with phases[6].why rewritten to name All Out's 120s cooldown and healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and late spikes never state the cooldowns that define them, and phases[6] claimed an Urgot two-item spike on a row the data gives to K'Sante.
audit.why: All Out is 120s at rank 1 falling to 80s — that is the window everything hinges on. Path Maker is 14s at rank 1 and Footwork 10s; those are the two things to bait before committing your pattern.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[6].why and mid now carry the 120s, 14s and 10s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fabrications and one slot swap. (a) 'Q's execute portion' / 'Q's outer-ring execute' — Corrosive Charge is damage plus a slow in Riot's text, with no execute component anywhere. (b) 'Your R ignores his defensive stats via execute' — Fear Beyond Death kills on a health threshold, it does not bypass resistances. (c) 'Your level-6 R executes him regardless of his HP' — it is a threshold, so his HP is the whole point. (d) 'his Q knock-up' and 'Q-stun' — Ntofo Strikes slows and, at two stacks, pulls; the knockback and stun are Path Maker (W).
audit.why: Each of these tells the player the wrong button did the wrong thing. The dangerous one is (c): a player who believes R kills at any health will press a 100-second ultimate into a full-health K'Sante.
audit.corrected: Q described as the 800-range slow feeding Purge's Echoing Flames legs; R described as a health-threshold execute; the stun attributed to Path Maker and the pull to Ntofo Strikes at two stacks. Also added the two absent interactions: Footwork shields him (bait it before you commit) and All Out heals him (Grievous Wounds). Per the mirror, Path Maker is damage reduction while charging — NOT unstoppable — and that wording is used here.
